Founded in 2020, it builds enterprise generative AI products including the Solar family of large language models and document processing technology such as document parsing, automated task execution, and a Universal Information Extractor. Its tools are used by large enterprises including Samsung, as well as Korean insurance firms and government institutions. * * * #### Founded 2020 #### HQ ![South Korea](https://flagcdn.com/w40/kr.png)Yongin #### Website [upstage.ai](https://www.upstage.ai/) #### Status Privately held #### Customer focus B2B #### Revenue model Subscription, Usage-based #### Revenue $19M (Oct 2026) #### Valuation $1.5B (Oct 2026) #### Sectors [Pure-Play AI Software](https://multiples.vc/pure-play-ai-software-valuation-multiples) [Financial Services Software](https://multiples.vc/financial-services-software-valuation-multiples) [Generative AI](https://multiples.vc/generative-ai-valuation-multiples) [B2B SaaS](https://multiples.vc/b2b-saas-valuation-multiples) [Vertical SaaS](https://multiples.vc/vertical-saas-valuation-multiples) [FinTech](https://multiples.vc/fintech-valuation-multiples) ### Upstage Valuation Upstage is currently valued at $1.5B, based on its Series C in October 2026. [Read the announcement ↗](https://www.asiae.co.kr/en/article/2026102008501890555) The $30M round included JB Woori Capital Company, Kwangju Bank, Jeonbuk Bank and JB Financial Group Co. Upstage's valuation has grown 2.0x from $750M at its strategic investment round in February 2026 to $1.5B in October 2026, across 3 priced rounds. #### Upstage valuation by funding round Revenue multiple | Date | Stage | Valuation | Revenue Multiple | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Oct 2026 | Series C | $1.5B | 78.5x | | Apr 2026 | Series C | $661M | - | | Feb 2026 | Strategic investment | $750M | 53.6x | Upstage valuation by funding round ### Upstage Revenue Upstage's latest recorded revenue is $19M, as of its Series C in October 2026. At a $1.5B valuation, that implies a 78.5x revenue multiple. Revenue grew from $14M in February 2026 to $19M in October 2026, while the revenue multiple moved from 53.6x to 78.5x. #### Upstage revenue by funding round | Date | Revenue \* | Valuation | Revenue Multiple | Stage | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Oct 2026 | $19M | $1.5B | 78.5x | Series C | | Feb 2026 | $14M | $750M | 53.6x | Strategic investment | Upstage revenue and valuation multiple by funding round \\* Revenue (or ARR) figures are the values recorded alongside each funding round. Typically run-rate revenue at the time of the deal, or a reported LTM (last 12 months) revenue. ### Upstage Funding History Upstage has raised a total of $352M across 8 funding rounds. Upstage's first fundraising round was a $27M Series A in September 2021. The most recent completed round was a $30M Series C in October 2026. #### Upstage funding rounds | Date | Stage | Investors | Raised | Valuation | Deal Summary | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Oct 2026 | Series C | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wooricap.com&size=64)JB Woori Capital C…,![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kjbank.com&size=64)Kwangju Bank +2JB Woori Capital Company; Kwangju Bank; Jeonbuk Bank; JB Financial Group Co | $30M | $1.5B | JB Financial Group announced on 20 October 2026 that three o…JB Financial Group announced on 20 October 2026 that three of its subsidiaries, Jeonbuk Bank, Kwangju Bank and JB Woori Capital, had signed an investment agreement to invest KRW 40 billion in the South Korean AI company Upstage. The investment forms the first tranche of Upstage's Series C-2 round, which the three affiliates led and which Upstage plans to keep raising funds in. Through it, JB Financial Group secured an approximately 2 percent stake in Upstage. Group chairman Kim Ki-hong said the investment reflects the group's determination to make AI collaboration go beyond declarations and lead to tangible changes at its subsidiaries. The two companies had signed a strategic memorandum in September 2026 to develop AI agents tailored to the financial sector, including joint development, training and staff exchanges. Upstage develops large language models and enterprise document-processing products, including its Upstage Studio platform, and became Korea's first generative AI unicorn with its Series C in April 2026. The company began with seed investment in 2020 and has raised funds in successive rounds since. | | Apr 2026 | Series C | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fprimersazze.com%2F&size=64)Primer Sazze Partn…,![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.woorivp.com%2Fhome%2Fen%2Fmain%2Fmain.do&size=64)Woori Venture Part… +8Primer Sazze Partners (lead); Woori Venture Partners; KB Securities; Hyundai; Mirae Asset Venture Investment; Premier Partners; InterVest Co.; Axiom Asia Private Capital; Kia; Shinhan Venture Investment | $119M | $661M | - | | Feb 2026 | Strategic investment | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sknetworks.co.kr&size=64)[SK Networks](https://multiples.vc/public-comps/sk-networks-valuation-multiples "SK Networks")SK Networks (lead) | $33M | $750M | - | | Aug 2025 | Series B | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kdb.co.kr&size=64)Korea Development…,![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.kbsec.co.kr%2F&size=64)KB Securities +7Korea Development Bank (lead); KB Securities; AMD; Mirae Asset Venture Investment; Premier Partners; InterVest Co.; Primer Sazze Partners; Amazon Web Services; Shinhan Venture Investment | $45M | - | Upstage, a South Korean AI software company headquartered in…Upstage, a South Korean AI software company headquartered in Yongin with a U.S. office in San Jose, specializes in enterprise-grade generative AI solutions, including its proprietary Solar language model family and advanced document processing technology. The company's offerings include document parsing, automated task execution, workflow management, and a Universal Information Extractor used by Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung and widely adopted by Korean insurance firms and government institutions.
In August 2025, Upstage completed a $45 million Series B bridge round led by Korea Development Bank, with new strategic investors Amazon and AMD joining existing investors including KB Securities, Shinhan Venture Investment, Mirae Asset Venture Investment, Primer Sazze Partners, and Premier Partners. The round brought Upstage's cumulative funding to $157 million, making it the most-funded AI software company in South Korea and positioning it toward unicorn status.
The capital will support development of next-generation Solar capabilities, advance document AI products, fund sales and marketing expansion, and accelerate go-to-market efforts in the U.S. and Asia Pacific regions.
This bridge round follows Upstage's $72 million Series B announced in April 2024, and the company was additionally recognized as the lead organization in Korea's national consortium for Independent AI Foundation Model Development by the Ministry of Science and ICT. | | Apr 2024 | Series B | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.hanaventures.co.kr%2F&size=64)Hana Ventures,![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ibk.co.kr&size=64)[Industrial Bank of…](https://multiples.vc/public-comps/industrial-bank-of-korea-valuation-multiples "Industrial Bank of Korea") +9Hana Ventures (lead); Industrial Bank of Korea (lead); Korea Development Bank (lead); KT (lead); Mirae Asset Venture Investment (lead); SK Networks; SBVA; Premier Partners; Primer Sazze Partners; Company K Partners; Shinhan Venture Investment | $72M | - | Upstage is a South Korean AI startup founded in October 2020…Upstage is a South Korean AI startup founded in October 2020 that specializes in large language models (LLMs) and document processing technologies. The company developed Solar LLM, a flagship product that delivers GPT-4-level performance with high speed and cost-efficiency, and Document AI, a solution leveraging optical character recognition to automate document processing workflows in finance, healthcare, and other regulated industries. Notable clients include Samsung and Hanwha.
On April 16, 2024, Upstage announced a Series B funding round raising $72 million from a consortium of investors including SK Networks, KT, Korea Development Bank, Shinhan Venture Investment, Hana Ventures, Mirae Asset Venture Investment, and Industrial Bank of Korea (IBK Securities), alongside existing investors SBVA (formerly SoftBank Ventures Asia), Primer Sazze Partners, Company K Partners, and Premier Partners.
This round brought Upstage's cumulative funding to over $100 million since its founding, making it the most-funded AI software company in South Korea. The capital was intended to accelerate development of purpose-trained LLMs for global enterprises and expand its U.S. operations, including a new subsidiary established in February 2024 with headquarters in San Jose, California. The company planned to focus on enterprise-specific AI solutions for regulated industries while advancing open-source initiatives around data preprocessing and LLM evaluation. | | Jan 2024 | Series B | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sknetworks.co.kr&size=64)[SK Networks](https://multiples.vc/public-comps/sk-networks-valuation-multiples "SK Networks")SK Networks (lead) | $19M | - | Upstage is a Seoul-based generative AI startup specializing…Upstage is a Seoul-based generative AI startup specializing in small-scale Large Language Models (ssLLMs) like Solar, which topped Hugging Face's Open LLM Leaderboard in December 2023 and won multiple Kaggle competitions. It focuses on private, domain-specific models for information security, serving government agencies and financial institutions. SK Networks, an affiliate of SK Group, led Upstage's Series B funding round in December 2024 at CES with a 25 billion won ($19 million) investment, part of a larger $72 million Series B involving Korean investors including Shinhan Venture Investment. The deal aimed to support Upstage's global expansion using SK Networks' network and its data solutions subsidiary en-core.
This Series B investment positioned SK Networks for deeper involvement, leading to a follow-on exercise of a call option in February 2026 with an additional 47 billion won ($33 million) for a 6.50% stake. In August 2025, Upstage raised a $45 million Series B bridge from KDB, Amazon, and AMD, bringing total funding to $157 million to enhance Solar, document AI, and U.S./APAC expansion, building on AWS collaboration.
Upstage continued aggressive growth post-Series B, pursuing acquisitions like Daum portal for LLM data and government projects such as Korea's Independent AI Foundation Model. | | Sep 2023 | Strategic investment | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcorp.kt.com&size=64)[KT](https://multiples.vc/public-comps/kt-valuation-multiples "KT")KT (lead) | $8M | - | Upstage Co., Ltd. received KRW 10 billion in funding from KT…Upstage Co., Ltd. received KRW 10 billion in funding from KT Corporation announced on September 10, 2023, with the transaction closing on September 11, 2023.
KT Corporation participated as a new investor in the round. | | Sep 2021 | Series A | ![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.kpartners.co.kr&size=64)[Company K Partners](https://multiples.vc/public-comps/company-k-partners-valuation-multiples "Company K Partners"),![](https://t1.gstatic.com/faviconV2?client=SOCIAL&type=FAVICON&fallback_opts=TYPE,SIZE,URL&url=https%3A%2F%2Fsbvacorp.com&size=64)SBVA +4Company K Partners (lead); SBVA (lead); TBT Partners; Premier Partners; Primer Sazze Partners; Stonebridge Ventures | $27M | - | Upstage is a South Korea-based AI startup founded in October…Upstage is a South Korea-based AI startup founded in October 2020 by experts from Naver CLOVA, including Kim Sung-hoon, Lee Hwal-suk, and Park Eun-Jeong. The company develops AI integrated solutions like AI Pack to enhance corporate core businesses, with a focus on technical skills in areas such as OCR, translation modeling, and large language models. In its first 8 months after inception, Upstage generated 8.8 billion won in revenue and received inquiries from over 100 companies on AI adoption.
In September 2021, Upstage raised $27.3 million (31.6 billion KRW) in a Series A round led by Company K Partners and SoftBank Ventures Asia (SBVA), with participation from Premier Partners, Primer Sazze Partners, Stonebridge Ventures, and TBT Partners. Proceeds were allocated to accelerate AI Pack development and hire over 200 AI developers domestically and internationally by 2022.
Upstage has since progressed with a $72 million Series B in April 2024 led by SK Networks, KT, and others including existing investors like SBVA and Company K Partners, bringing cumulative funding over $100 million at that time. A $45 million Series B bridge followed in August 2025 with KDB, Amazon, and AMD, raising total capital to $157 million to scale Document AI, Solar LLMs, and global expansion into the US and APAC. | Upstage funding rounds ### Who has invested in Upstage? 25 investors have backed Upstage across its funding rounds, including Premier Partners, Primer Sazze Partners, Mirae Asset Venture Investment, Shinhan Venture Investment, SK Networks and Korea Development Bank.
